title: The Swallow and the Spider
summary: A spider spun a web across an open window hoping to catch a swallow. The bird flew through without noticing, tearing the web and leaving the spider to lament her foolish ambition....
full_text: A spider spun a web across an open window hoping to catch a swallow. The bird flew through without noticing, tearing the web and leaving the spider to lament her foolish ambition.
moral: The web woven for small flies cannot withstand the swallow’s flight.
